Accessible Holidays

Tourist-Information Nonnenhorn

Content on this page
  • Information on accessibility
  • Address & contact

Description

Our tourist information office offers a variety of flyers and brochures as well as accessible toilets, including wheelchair-friendly toilets.

A ground-floor entrance area leads to the foyer in the basement of the Haus des Gastes, also known as "Stedi". During opening hours, the staff at the tourist information office are the point of contact for all questions about Nonnenhorn, excursions, appointments and much more. The building is also open at weekends and in the evenings, as there is a pizzeria on the upper floor. This ensures access to flyers and information material about Nonnenhorn and the excursion destinations around Lake Constance. Outside opening hours, you can enter the building at any time with the Euro key and also have access to the public wheelchair-accessible toilet, which can also be unlocked with the Euro key.

Information on accessibility

Download short report as PDF
People with walking difficulties and wheelchair users

All areas relevant for testing meet the quality criteria of the label "Accessibility certified - parially accessible for people with walking disabilities".

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report. 

  • There is at least one parking space for people with disabilities.
  • All rooms and facilities that can be used by guests and are raised are accessible without steps/at ground level. 
  • All doors/passages and paths that can be used and are raised for the guest are at least 90 cm wide.
  • The counter is 104 cm high, there is no alternative means of communication while seated.
  • There is a public toilet for people with disabilities, which can be accessed from one side (at least 90 cm). A grab rail hangs from the ceiling of the toilet.   
Test report - Walking disabilities
Test report - Wheelchair
People with visual impairments and blind people

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report. 

  • Assistance dogs are welcome.
  • The signage (for orientation) is designed in easy-to-read, high-contrast lettering.
  • All areas are brightly lit and glare-free.
  • Stair treads are not visually rich in contrast. The stairs have handrails on both sides. 
  • Information is not available in Braille or prismatic writing.
Test report
People with hearing impairments and deaf people

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report. 

  • There is no audio induction loop system available. 
Test report
People with cognitive impairments

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report. 

  • The name of the tourist information office is clearly recognizable from the outside. 
  • The destinations of the routes are within sight or there are signs at a constantly visible distance. 
  • There is no information in plain language. 
Test report
Certified in the period: October 2024 – September 2027

Der Inhalt wird dir nicht angezeigt?

Zum Schutz deiner Daten setzen wir eine sog. Zwei-Klick-Lösung ein. Die Cookies von YouTube und Google Maps sind bei uns standardmäßig deaktiviert und werden erst nach dem Klick auf die Schaltfläche „Akzeptieren“ von den jeweiligen Servern geladen. Danach kannst du die Inhalte sehen. Mit dem Klick willigst du ein, dass deine IP-Adresse an YouTube bzw. Google Maps übertragen wird, und dass der Anbieter Cookies in deinem Browser setzt. Für deinen Komfort merken wir uns deine Einwilligung für 1 Jahr über ein sog. Local Storage Objekt, das wir in deinem Browser speichern. Natürlich kannst du diese auch selbstständig in deinen Browser-Einstellugen entfernen, wenn du das nicht möchtest. Mehr Informationen darüber findest du in unseren Datenschutzhinweisen.
